## Today

`app-phone/src/androidTest/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ExampleInstrumentedTest.kt`
is the unmodified Android Studio template test (`useAppContext`,
asserting the package name). `app-phone/build.gradle.kts` declares
`testInstrumentationRunner` and the `androidTest*` dependencies
(`androidx.test.ext.junit`, `androidx.espresso.core`,
`androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4`) that this file needs to compile, but
no Gradle task in the project's task graph runs `connectedAndroidTest`
or any `androidTest` variant — `./gradlew :app-phone:check` only
compiles and runs `src/test` plus `lint`, per
`docs/TECHNICAL_CONVENTIONS.md` §14 ("Compose UI tests are written in
`src/test`, with Robolectric. `androidTest` is never used — nothing in
the task graph runs it.").

## Expected

`app-phone` carries no `androidTest` source set: the template file is
deleted, and the `androidTest*`-only dependencies it required
(`androidx.test.ext.junit`, `androidx.espresso.core`) are removed from
`app-phone/build.gradle.kts` since nothing else in the module uses
them. Compose UI coverage, if any is required, lives in `src/test`
under Robolectric, consistent with the rest of the module.
